entry.en: Vatican City does not issue visas or residency permits to visitors and has open borders with Italy.
entry.es: La Ciudad del Vaticano no emite visados ni permisos de residencia a los visitantes y tiene fronteras abiertas con Italia.
entry.quote: Although the Vatican City is an independent country, it does not issue visas or residency permits to visitors; it has open borders with Italy.

entry.en: Since Italy is part of the Schengen area, its common visa policy applies.
entry.es: Como Italia forma parte del espacio Schengen, se aplica su política común de visados.
entry.quote: Since Italy is a part of the Schengen area, its common visa policy applies.

safety.en: Keep an eye on your belongings at all times.
safety.es: Vigila tus pertenencias en todo momento.
safety.quote: Keep an eye on your belongings at all times.

safety.en: The #64 bus is described as filled with pickpockets, so guard your valuables.
safety.es: Se describe el autobús n.º 64 como lleno de carteristas, así que protege tus objetos de valor.
safety.quote: it is filled with pickpockets so guard your valuables!

safety.en: Tour touts are often seen near Ottaviano station, and some may falsely claim that St. Peter's Basilica is closed.
safety.es: Es frecuente ver captadores de tours cerca de la estación Ottaviano y algunos pueden afirmar falsamente que la basílica de San Pedro está cerrada.
safety.quote: Tour touts are often seen near Ottaviano station, and some may falsely claim that St. Peter's Basilica is closed

safety.en: Vatican authorities regularly collaborate with Italian authorities, and you can also expect to be prosecuted under Italian laws.
safety.es: Las autoridades vaticanas colaboran regularmente con las italianas y también puedes ser procesado según las leyes italianas.
safety.quote: Vatican authorities regularly collaborate with Italian authorities and you can also expect to be prosecuted under Italian laws.

safety.en: The Vatican can get overcrowded at times.
safety.es: El Vaticano a veces puede estar muy masificado.
safety.quote: The Vatican can get overcrowded at times.

health.en: There are no hospitals or medical clinics in the Vatican.
health.es: No hay hospitales ni clínicas en el Vaticano.
health.quote: There are no hospitals or medical clinics in the Vatican.

help.en: As throughout Europe, the local emergency number is 112.
help.es: Como en toda Europa, el número local de emergencias es el 112.
help.quote: As is the case throughout Europe, the local emergency number here is 112.

getting_in.en: There are three road entrances to Vatican City: Via della Stazione Vaticana, Via Paolo VI and Borgo Pio.
getting_in.es: Hay tres entradas por carretera a la Ciudad del Vaticano: Via della Stazione Vaticana, Via Paolo VI y Borgo Pio.
getting_in.quote: There are three road entrances to Vatican City: from Via della Stazione Vaticana, Via Paolo VI and Borgo Pio.

getting_in.en: The closest airport is Rome's Leonardo da Vinci-Fiumicino Airport (FCO).
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto más cercano es el de Roma Leonardo da Vinci-Fiumicino (FCO).
getting_in.quote: The closest airport is the Leonardo da Vinci-Fiumicino Airport (FCO IATA) of Rome.

getting_in.en: For the Vatican Museums, the #49 bus goes from western Rome to the northern end of Vatican City.
getting_in.es: Para los Museos Vaticanos, el autobús n.º 49 va desde el oeste de Roma hasta el extremo norte de la Ciudad del Vaticano.
getting_in.quote: For the Vatican Museums, the #49 bus goes from western Rome to the northern end of Vatican City.

getting_in.en: The Vatican has its own train station, but there are no regular scheduled passenger services.
getting_in.es: El Vaticano tiene su propia estación de tren, pero no hay servicios regulares de pasajeros.
getting_in.quote: The Vatican has its own train station, however, there are no regular scheduled passenger services.

getting_around.en: The Vatican is small enough to be explored on foot, and you can easily cover it in 30-60 minutes.
getting_around.es: El Vaticano es lo bastante pequeño para recorrerlo a pie y se puede ver fácilmente en 30-60 minutos.
getting_around.quote: the Vatican is small enough to be explored on foot. You can easily cover the Vatican in 30-60 minutes this way.

getting_around.en: Visitors are not allowed to drive around the Vatican without permission from the Vatican authorities.
getting_around.es: Los visitantes no pueden conducir por el Vaticano sin permiso de las autoridades vaticanas.
getting_around.quote: Visitors (including Italian citizens) are not allowed to drive around the Vatican without permission from the Vatican authorities.

money.en: Vatican euro coins are the rarest in circulation among European countries, so the text says not to spend them.
money.es: Las monedas de euro del Vaticano son las más escasas en circulación entre los países europeos, por lo que el texto aconseja no gastarlas.
money.quote: The Vatican euro coins are the rarest in circulation among European countries, so don't spend them!

etiquette.en: Dress appropriately, with no sleeveless shirts, shorts, flip-flops, trainers or skirts not covering the knee, or you will be refused entry to various places.
etiquette.es: Viste adecuadamente, sin camisetas sin mangas, pantalones cortos, chanclas, zapatillas deportivas ni faldas que no cubran la rodilla, o te negarán la entrada a varios lugares.
etiquette.quote: Dress appropriately — no sleeveless shirts, shorts, flip-flops, trainers, or skirts that do not cover the knee — or else you will be refused entry to various places around the Vatican.

etiquette.en: If you are not a baptized and confirmed Catholic, you should not receive Holy Communion.
etiquette.es: Si no eres católico bautizado y confirmado, no debes recibir la Sagrada Comunión.
etiquette.quote: if you are not a baptized and confirmed Catholic, you should not receive Holy Communion.

etiquette.en: Photography and filming in the Vatican are permitted, except in the Sistine Chapel.
etiquette.es: Se permite fotografiar y filmar en el Vaticano, excepto en la Capilla Sixtina.
etiquette.quote: Photography and filming in the Vatican are permitted, except in the Sistine Chapel.

etiquette.en: Smoking has been banned in the Vatican since 2002.
etiquette.es: Fumar está prohibido en el Vaticano desde 2002.
etiquette.quote: Smoking has been banned by the Vatican since 2002

connectivity.en: Telephone numbers in Vatican City are integrated into the Italian telephone numbering plan.
connectivity.es: Los números de teléfono de la Ciudad del Vaticano están integrados en el plan de numeración italiano.
connectivity.quote: Telephone numbers in Vatican City are integrated into the Italian telephone numbering plan.
